title: 安全なウェブサイトの作り方
custom_rule_scope: overview page to publication body handoff
normalization_risks: navigation-heavy landing page before body content
supplemental pages may appear as sibling documents instead of a single article
Japanese heading variants require stable section ids
success_criteria: main body excludes IPA site navigation and footer blocks
chapter and supplement boundaries become stable section ids
appendix checklist items survive as ordered or bulleted content

title: 非機能要求グレード
normalization_risks: legacy archive HTML may mix body and navigation markup
list-like artifacts may not be semantically marked up
related links can overwhelm body extraction
success_criteria: legacy archive chrome is removed cleanly
grade artifacts and procedure steps remain structured
reference links are separated from normative body text

title: 重要情報を扱うシステムの要求策定ガイド
normalization_risks: modern IPA pages may interleave article body with campaign or download blocks
supplemental note sections may carry duplicated teaser text
success_criteria: step headings normalize into stable section ids
requirements bullets and lists remain structured
non-body promotional or related download blocks are removed

title: The NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0

expected_structure.subsections: categories such as profiles, tiers, implementation notes

normalization_risks: NIST publication pages often mix summary, download metadata, and body
function pages may include repeated navigation anchors
resource sections can be useful but should not dominate core body extraction
success_criteria: overview and six functions are preserved as first-class sections
download metadata and repeated anchors are excluded
profiles, tiers, and quick-start content remain available as subordinate sections

title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations
normalization_risks: publication landing page includes versioning and planning notes around the body
control-family concepts may appear in long publication summaries rather than semantic sections
future update notices must not alter stable ids for the chosen update
success_criteria: Update 1 remains the fixed source version
control family groups normalize into stable sections
planning notes and publication chrome stay out of the corpus body
